name: Emberheart
text:
This small, heart-shaped amulet appears to be sculpted from stone with a single streak of dim light running through, like an ember just beneath ashes. When worn, the amulet gives off a gentle warmth, akin to being near a fireplace. You gain poison resistance 15 when wearing this amulet.

When you invest the amulet, you either increase your Constitution modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

---
Activate—Warming Heart 2 (healing, magical, manipulate, vitality)

Frequency once per day

Effect You hold the amulet aloft as a ripple of warm orange light exudes outward. Each ally in a 30-foot emanation regains 30 healing Hit Points and gains a +3 status bonus to Fortitude saves until the end of their next turn.

Effect: Emberheart
